cues: A diploid spermatogonium and a diploid oogonium multiply by mitosis.
One grows into a primary spermatocyte, or a primary oocyte, still diploid.
In the female the growth is enormous, because the oocyte stocks up yolk and machinery for the embryo.
text: Side by side. A diploid spermatogonium and a diploid oogonium multiply by mitosis. One grows into a primary spermatocyte, or a primary oocyte, still diploid. In the female the growth is enormous, because the oocyte stocks up yolk and machinery for the embryo.
